Stepping into your bathroom should be a place of calm and relaxation. The right bathroom-fitting accessories can turn an ordinary space into a stylish one. Whether designing a new bathroom or renovating an existing one, choosing suitable bath fittings is essential to upgrading both style and functionality.  
In today’s ever-changing world, timeless designs are becoming more popular. Classic bath fittings offer both style and durability, making them a great choice for any bathroom. Going for high-quality faucets, taps, and accessories ensures that your bathroom stays stylish and functional for years. The right fittings can keep your bathroom design together, creating a soothing and beautiful space.  
Prayag India has brought unique and stylish bathroom accessories and faucets to help you enhance your old bathroom. In this blog, you can discover suggested ways of bathroom styling with our different product ranges that are suitable for all kinds of customers.

Prayag India’s Products Range: Bathroom Fitting Accessories

  1. Sanitaryware: Prayag brings you a collection of sanitaryware inspired by French designs made with modern technology and style, which provides comfort and ease of use. We offer multiple designs and shapes in sanitaryware products, from single-piece or extended wall-hung commodes to an exclusive range of wash basins, cisterns, and seat covers.
  2. PTMT SYMET Range: PTMT is an advanced thermoplastic for kitchen and bathroom accessories. It is the finest material in terms of its performance and resistance. We provide an endless variety of symmetry ranges in different colours, shapes, and designs that will enhance the look of your bathroom.
  3. Showers: We have two types of showers: PTMT SYMET showers and chrome-plated showers. Both are designed to provide a comfortable and efficient bathing experience. Using PTMT and CP material ensures that the shower fittings are long-lasting and require minimal maintenance.
  4. CP Faucet: We offer an exclusive range of chrome-plated faucets, showers, towel holders, and soap dispenser that will give your bathroom a luxurious look. These bathroom-fitting accessories will add beauty and shine and transform your old, ordinary bathroom into a modern-day bathroom.
  5. Traps and Gratings: Traps and Gratings play crucial roles in ensuring your bathroom or kitchen’s functionality, hygiene, and safety. Both components are essential in maintaining an efficient drainage system while preventing unpleasant smell and wastage from causing blockages.

Choosing the Right Bath Fittings

Consider the following tips to help you make the best choice for your bathroom fittings:

  1. Align with Your Bathroom Style: Your bathroom style should guide your choice of fittings. For a modern look, go for sleek, minimalist designs. For a more traditional look, choose detailed and classic finishes.
  2. Focus on Quality: Investing in quality fittings will save money in the long run as high-quality products are less likely to require frequent repairs or replacements.
  3. Prioritize Functionality: Invest in a showerhead with multiple spray options if you enjoy long showers. For smaller spaces, look for compact fittings that maximize efficiency without sacrificing style.
  4. Coordinate Finishes: To create a solid look, ensure that all your fittings, including faucets, taps, and accessories, have matching finishes. This will create a matching design throughout your bathroom.
  5. Easy Installation: Some bath fittings are easier to install, especially if you’re upgrading an existing bathroom rather than building a new one. Consider whether the fitting you like will work with your existing fittings or require extra modifications.
  6. User Preferences and Needs: Consider who will be using the bathroom. For example, if you have young children, elderly family members, or people with disabilities, you might need to choose fittings that are easy to use, such as lever taps or temperature controllers.

Maintaining Bath Fittings

After investing in high-quality bathroom fitting accessories, it’s essential to maintain them properly. Here are some tips to keep your fittings in top condition:

  1. Regular Cleaning: Wipe your bathroom fittings with a soft cloth and a mild cleaning solution afterward. Avoid harsh cleaners that can damage the finish.
  2. Prevent Water Spots: Dry your fittings after each use to prevent water spots and mineral build up, especially in areas with hard water.
  3. Monitor Leaks: Regularly check for leaks around your taps and showerheads. Early detection can prevent water damage and extend the life of your fittings.
  4. Oil Moving Parts: If your taps or shower valves feel stiff, use a silicone-based lubricant to keep them moving smoothly.
  5. Replace Small Damaged Parts: Seals and washers may break down over time. Replace them as needed to maintain your fitting’s functionality.
